info.title: MAGDA Remote API
info.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over a loopback WebSocket, generated from MAGDA's operation registry; `system.describe` returns the same catalogue at runtime. `params` objects are closed: unknown fields are rejected.

servers.name: MAGDA WebSocket
servers.summary: The loopback listener of a running MAGDA
servers.description: Read `url` and `token` from the discovery record `remote-api-<pid>.json` in MAGDA's data directory. Name the client with `?client=<name>` and send the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
